data.name: Geetansh
data.gender_notes: Geetansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Geetansh is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Geeta' meaning song and 'Ansh' meaning form or manifestation. The name symbolizes the divine song or mantra that connects us to the Gods. The name Geetansh carries the meaning “Song of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Geetansh usually hope their child will grow to embody song of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Geetansh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
